title: PR #229: Competitive monitoring report and registry v0.2.4 — 2026-10-24
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

## Purpose

Daily targeted official-source review for 2026-10-24, compared with expanded registry v0.2.3 from 2026-10-22.

## Changes

- Add versioned delta overlay and expanded registry snapshot v0.2.4.
- Record the Ethereum Foundation's Hoodi Glamsterdam postponement as STATUS_CHANGED.
- Add first product-level baselines for ServiceNow Arc, ARIS Process Context for Enterprise AI, and Oracle Fusion Claw / HR agentic applications.
- Refresh selected official-source snapshots for Linux, Gemini pricing, MetaMask availability and Windows 11 release health.
- Narrow product-area taxonomy for the Google model/API, OpenAI Agents SDK and ServiceNow EmployeeWorks entries.
- Add the dated report and point the validation workflow at the latest base/overlay/template files.

## Scope and evidence limits

This is a targeted official-source review, not a full market census. First-time ADD records are baselines; their product announcement dates are preserved separately from this report's check date. Missing product pages, changelogs, tariffs and regional availability remain null/UNVERIFIED.

The existing scheduled workflow validates registry structure; it does not perform source crawling. No claim is made that daily source collection is already automated.

## Acceptance

- Draft only; do not merge until the latest exact-head validation run passes and the source claims are reviewed.
- A green validator proves registry/schema checks only, not vendor claims or operational monitoring.
- External runtime dependency remains false as the native implementation target.
